description: Call before paying, onboarding or contracting a company (KYB). Returns a clear action (allow / review / block), a 0-100 risk score and which official registries corroborate the company. Every response includes an Ed25519-signed receipt you can verify offline (public key: https://tolca.tonbot.ca/.well-known/tolca-receipt-key.json) or online at /receipts/verify. Every response includes an Ed25519-signed receipt you can verify offline (public key: https://tolca.tonbot.ca/.well-known/tolca-receipt-key.json) or online at /receipts/verify. One call: US, UK and EU sanctions lists (CSL incl. OFAC SDN), company registries (UK Companies House, Canada federal), legal entity status (GLEIF, worldwide), contractor licences (Québec, Washington, Oregon). Verdict ok / review / blocking / not_found with reasons. Input: name, optional country (ISO-2) and region (WA, OR, QC). Businesses only. Costs $0.05 USDC per call (x402 v2, Base). Send the HTTP header PAYMENT-SIGNATURE with your x402 payment, or call POST https://tolca.tonbot.ca/v1/verify-business with an x402 client.

country.description: ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code, e.g. US, CA, GB

region.description: State/province code: WA, OR or QC enables contractor-licence checks
